desc:
The boss just landed a mega project, and YOU are the builder!

Grab blocks from the block yard, ride the elevator and place them floor by floor. Everyone in the server builds the same skyscraper together. When it's finished, the top 3 builders get a statue on the podium!

🧱 Carry & build: more Strength = more blocks per trip
🏋️ Train at the Gym: bench press for Strength, treadmill for Speed
💪 Your builder gets more muscular as Strength grows
⚡ Upgrades: Block Grab, Build Speed, Build Range, Elevator Speed
🏆 Rank up and climb the leaderboards
👥 Play with friends for a boost
🎁 Free gift box
🌙 Day & night cycle

Can your crew build to the clouds?

🔎 Gökdeleni İnşa Et, Construye el Rascacielos, Bau den Wolkenkratzer, Construis le Gratte-Ciel, Costruisci il Grattacielo, Construa o Arranha-Céu, Построй Небоскрёб, Zbuduj Wieżowiec, Bangun Gedung Pencakar Langit, Xây Tòa Nhà Chọc Trời, สร้างตึกระฟ้า, 超高層ビルを建てよう, 마천루 짓기, 建造摩天大楼, 建造摩天大樓, गगनचुंबी इमारत बनाओ, ابنِ ناطحة السحاب
